acceptance_criteria: every new owner instruction is automatically persisted;
every instruction is compiled to validated machine-readable contracts;
every compiled contract creates traceable RootGoals and tasks;
all old active directives are migrated and classified;
Temporal canary survives restart and network failure;
Nomad schedules a real remote task;
ordinary Factory tasks no longer use SSH;
Telegram receives directive acceptance and completion;

Do not introduce a hypervisor as a mandatory dependency.
Do not treat every old document as active.

Do not allow streams or logs to grow without limits.

Do not store large PDFs, source archives, or model files directly in workflow
